Each entry: "fileId" (NSNumber), "chatId" (NSNumber), "messageId" (NSNumber), "name" (NSString, best-effort file name, may be empty), "size" (bytes, NSNumber - 0 when TDLib did not include the file object), "downloaded" (bytes, NSNumber, same caveat), "isPaused" (NSNumber BOOL), "isComplete" (NSNumber BOOL), "date" (NSNumber, unix time it was added). `counts` has "active", "paused" and "completed" (NSNumber). `nextOffset` is an empty string when there is no further page.

name: forgetAutoDownloadSettingsMirror
doc: Drop the mirror above, e.g. on logout.

name: resetNetworkStats
doc: Zero the network counters.

name: setDownloadPaused
doc: Pause or resume a single download.

name: suggestedFileNameForFile
doc: The file name TDLib suggests when exporting a file into `directory`, or nil.

name: addStories
doc: Add, remove or reorder album members. `completion` gets the updated album.

name: archivedStoriesInChat
doc: Our expired stories, newest first. `fromStoryId` is 0 for the first page, then the id of the oldest story already shown.

name: closeFriendsWithCompletion
doc: The close friends list: "id", "name", "username".

name: editStory
doc: Replace the content of a story with another local photo.

name: markStoryRead
doc: Mark a story read without showing it - open immediately followed by close.

name: profileStoriesInChat
sig: - (void)profileStoriesInChat:(int64_t)chatId fromStoryId:(NSInteger)fromStoryId limit:(NSInteger)limit completion:(void (^)(NSArray *stories, NSArray *pinnedIds, NSInteger total))completion
doc: Stories a chat keeps on its profile page. `pinnedIds` are the subset shown at the top.

name: publicForwardsOfStory
doc: Public reposts and forwards of a story. Each entry: "chatId", "title", "date", "isStory" (NSNumber BOOL), "storyId" when it is a repost.

name: reorderStoryAlbums
doc: Album ids in the order they should appear.

name: resolveStoryLink
doc: Resolve a t.me story link into something the viewer can open. `completion` gets the poster chat id and story id, or (0, 0) when the link is not a story link or the username does not resolve.

name: searchStoriesAtVenueProvider
sig: - (void)searchStoriesAtVenueProvider:(NSString *)provider venueId:(NSString *)venueId offset:(NSString *)offset limit:(NSInteger)limit completion:(void (^)(NSArray *stories, NSString *nextOffset, NSInteger total))completion
doc: Public stories posted at a venue, as an interactive venue area links to.

name: searchStoriesWithTag
sig: - (void)searchStoriesWithTag:(NSString *)tag posterChatId:(int64_t)posterChatId offset:(NSString *)offset limit:(NSInteger)limit completion:(void (^)(NSArray *stories, NSString *nextOffset, NSInteger total))completion
doc: Public stories carrying a hashtag. Pass 0 for `posterChatId` to search everywhere. `offset` is nil for the first page.

name: setCloseFriends
doc: Replace the close friends list wholesale with these user ids.

name: setPinnedStories
doc: Replace the pinned story ids of a profile.

name: setStoryPreloading
doc: Whether stories are fetched ahead of time on the given network. Off is the right default on this hardware. `type` is "mobile" or "wifi".

name: setStoryReactionNotificationSource
doc: Who may trigger a notification when they react to our story. `source` is "all", "contacts" or "none". Note this rewrites the whole reaction notification record, so message-reaction and poll sources follow it.

name: storiesInAlbum
sig: - (void)storiesInAlbum:(NSInteger)albumId inChat:(int64_t)chatId offset:(NSInteger)offset limit:(NSInteger)limit completion:(void (^)(NSArray *stories, NSInteger total))completion
doc: Contents of one album, flattened stories.

name: storyAlbumsInChat
doc: Story albums of a chat: "id", "name".

name: deleteLanguagePack
doc: Remove a downloaded pack. Fails on the pack currently in use, so switch away first. Completion gets YES when it was actually deleted.

name: languagePackStrings
doc: Strings of a pack, for a TGLang-style lookup layer. Pass nil or an empty `keys` array for the whole pack. Completion gets a dictionary keyed by the string key; an ordinary value maps to an NSString, a pluralised one to a dictionary with the "zero"/"one"/"two"/"few"/"many"/"other" keys that are present. Deleted strings are omitted. Never nil, empty on failure.

name: languagePacksWithCompletion
doc: Every language pack this account can see, richer than TGClient's -languagesWithCompletion:. Each entry is a dictionary with keys: "id", "name", "nativeName", "pluralCode", "baseId", "official" (NSNumber bool), "rtl", "beta", "installed", "totalStrings", "translatedStrings", "localStrings", "translationUrl". `current` is the language_pack_id in effect. Falls back to the local-only list when the server refuses. Completion gets an empty array (never nil) if there is nothing at all.

name: rateSpeechRecognitionForMessage
doc: Send the Good / Bad feedback offered under a finished transcript.

name: speechTranscriptForMessage
doc: Current transcription state of a message. Completion gets a dictionary: "state" is "pending", "text" or "error"; "text" is the partial or final transcript ("" while nothing is available); "error" is a human-readable message when state is "error". Completion gets nil when the message has no voice or video note, or has never been transcribed - that is the "show the transcribe glyph" case.

name: synchronizeLanguagePack
doc: Pull the newest strings of a pack from the server. Fire and forget.

name: translateText
doc: Translate arbitrary text (composer contents, a bio, a caption). Completion gets the translated plain text, or nil on failure.

name: badgesForChat
doc: The same for a chat; channels and supergroups carry their own verification mark. Keys "isVerified", "isScam", "isFake" (NSNumber BOOL). Never nil.

name: closeChat
doc: Tell TDLib the chat left the screen. Call from viewWillDisappear:.

name: customEmojiIconsForIds
doc: Resolve custom emoji ids to drawable icons in one call, for a list screen that needs several badges at once. `ids` are NSNumber custom emoji ids. `completion` gets a dictionary keyed by the id as an NSString, each value shaped like -emojiStatusForUser:. Missing ids are simply absent.

name: groupOnlineSummaryForChat
doc: "N members, M online" for a group or supergroup, ready for the navigation bar subtitle. `online` is 0 for anything that is not a group. The count is sampled from the members TDLib has cached (up to 50 recent ones in a supergroup), so it is exact for small groups and a lower bound for large ones. Call -openChat: first for TDLib to keep statuses fresh.

name: hiddenStatusHintForStatusInfo
doc: Explanatory line for tapping an approximate status, or nil when the status is exact and there is nothing to explain. Says that the precise time is hidden because the signed-in user hides their own, when that is the reason.

name: privacyRuleDetail
doc: Full picture of one privacy setting, beyond the everybody/contacts/nobody scalar -privacyRule:completion: returns. `setting` is the TDLib name without the "userPrivacySetting" prefix: "ShowStatus", "ShowProfilePhoto", "ShowPhoneNumber", "ShowBio", "AllowCalls", "AllowChatInvites", "AllowFindingByPhoneNumber", "ShowLinkInForwardedMessages". Keys: "value" ("everybody" / "contacts" / "nobody"), "allowedUserIds", "restrictedUserIds", "allowedChatIds", "restrictedChatIds" (NSArray of NSNumber, possibly empty). Nil on failure.

name: profileGradientForColorId
doc: Two gradient stops (0xRRGGBB NSNumbers, top then bottom) for a profile accent colour id, or nil when `colorId` is negative, which means the peer uses the plain profile header.

name: rgbForAccentColorId
doc: Name colour for a built-in accent colour id, as 0xRRGGBB. Ids outside the seven built-in colours are folded back into them, so this always answers. Use it to colour a name synchronously once an id is known.

name: setSelfOnline
doc: Publish or withdraw our own presence to peers. Call with YES from applicationDidBecomeActive: and NO from applicationDidEnterBackground:; without this our account looks permanently offline to everyone else.

name: statusInfoForUser
doc: The same dictionary for one user, fetched from TDLib's local cache when it has one. `completion` also gets "userId". Never nil.

name: statusInfoForUserStatus
doc: Format a raw TDLib UserStatus object (the "status" field of a user, or the "status" of an updateUserStatus) into what a subtitle shows. Keys: "text" (NSString, e.g. "online", "last seen yesterday at 21:04"), "isOnline" (NSNumber BOOL), "rank" (NSNumber, higher sorts first in a contacts list), "wasOnline" (NSNumber unix time, 0 when unknown), "isApproximate" (NSNumber BOOL - recently/week/month, no exact time), and "hiddenByMyPrivacy" (NSNumber BOOL - the exact time is withheld because the signed-in user hides their own last seen). Never nil, so a malformed status still yields a drawable subtitle.

name: applicationDownloadLinkWithCompletion
doc: Download link for this application, for the invite-friends SMS body.

name: publicLinkForStickerSetName
doc: t.me link to a sticker set by its short name. Nil on failure.

name: publicLinkForUsername
doc: t.me link to a public chat / user by username. Nil on failure.

name: chatsInFolder
doc: Chats of one folder.

name: notificationsMutedForScope
doc: Notification settings are kept per scope rather than per chat: private chats, groups and channels each have their own. `scope` is "private", "groups" or "channels"; `muted` is what the switch shows.

name: premiumStateWithCompletion
doc: Premium state of the signed-in account: nil when it is not active.

name: sessionsWithCompletion
doc: Other devices signed into this account: "id", "name", "platform", "ip", "isCurrent", "lastActive".

name: userForPhone
doc: Resolve an address-book phone number to a Telegram user, or nil. Same dictionary shape as -contactsWithCompletion:.
